title: Compactification diagrams with open restriction
statement: Fix a finite-field datum D, with algebraic closure k, and an integer l. Define an open compactification diagram to consist of quasi-separated finite-type k-schemes X,Y,U,V, separated finite-type k-morphisms f:X→Y and f':U→V, arbitrary quasi-compact open scheme morphisms u:U→X and v:V→Y, compactifications c of f and c' of f', and w:c'.Z→c.Z. Supply chosen Cartesian proper and open squares identifying c' with the pullback of c. Require the four corners and both middle schemes to be Noetherian and finite dimensional, and supply the stalk-unit certificates for l at the corners. The open maps need not be k-linear, so isomorphism transport includes semilinear maps. Define an isomorphism of two such whole diagrams to consist of the six corner/middle scheme isomorphisms, their proper and open Cartesian squares, the Cartesian squares for u and v, and commutation with w. Its two support-transport diagrams are the corresponding unprimed and primed compactification base-change squares. These are bundles of the existing schemes, properties, compactifications, and chosen square witnesses; no operation is replaced. The constituent notions are [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], [def-pc-fibre-product], [def-weil-open-immersion], [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], [def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square], [def-cbc-open-immersion-square], [def-kun-topological-krull-dimension], [pqf-def-locnoeth]. Include the actual identity open diagram, a further open restriction with its shared middle compactification, the second and outer diagrams formed by Cartesian pasting, and the support diagram of an automorphism.
